'''Malosaurs''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of saurian [[Reptile/Legends|reptiles]] [[Mutant|mutated]] from the [[DNA/Legends|DNA]] of [[malkloc]]s, a similarly massive beast native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. However, unlike malklocs, these [[Bioengineering/Legends|bioengineered]] malosaurs had sharper [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]], a spikier back, and predominant horns protruding from its cranial area. Malosaurs also had a more subdued palette of [[Color/Legends|blue]] and brown.<ref name="AED" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Malosaur.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A malosaur]]
Malosaurs were [[W:c:swg:Creatures & enemies|creatures]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Little to no records of the malosaur appearing on the live [[W:c:swg:Server|servers]] exists. However, according to an archived [[W:c:swg:Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided|''Galaxies'']] forum post backed up on a player website, Designer [[Mikkel Jensen|Mikeel "Hjal" Jensen]] confirmed that they were implemented.<ref name="Developer">{{WebCite|url=http://swgcraft.org/dev/tracker.php?id=17770|text=''BBP RESEARCH LOG''|nobackup=1}}</ref>
